bindcraft.install: vendored: stock/src/bindcraft/ (BindCraft is not a Python distribution; its design step is imported from the vendored files by opt/colabdesign_opt/bindcraft.py); the prebuilt DSSP executable functions/dssp is not carried: `run.sh install` fetches it from the repository at this commit into stock/src/bindcraft/functions/dssp, checks its sha256 and sets mode 755 (install_bindcraft.sh's `chmod +x`) — `fetched` below; functions/DAlphaBall.gcc is neither carried nor fetched (the PyRosetta stage that uses it is not run by this kit)

fetched.why: BindCraft's repository carries two prebuilt third-party executables whose licences it does not state, functions/dssp and functions/DAlphaBall.gcc; this tree distributes neither (both are left out of the archive above and of stock/src/). The design step runs DSSP (biopython_utils.calc_ss_percentage, settings optimise_beta), so `run.sh install` fetches that one file from upstream as published at the pinned commit; DAlphaBall.gcc serves only the PyRosetta stage, which this kit does not run, and is not fetched

recipe.driver: stock/src/bindcraft/functions/colabdesign_utils.py binder_hallucination(design_name, starting_pdb, chain, target_hotspot_residues, length, seed, helicity_value, design_models, advanced_settings, design_paths, failure_csv) — BindCraft's design step (model build, losses, the 4-stage schedule with its pLDDT gates, the optimise_beta DSSP check, the CA-clash / pLDDT / contact triage, plots and animation as the settings say), imported unmodified and called by opt/colabdesign_opt/bindcraft.py in both arms
recipe.derivation: stock/src/bindcraft/bindcraft.py — advanced_settings = perform_advanced_settings_check(<settings>, <stock/src/bindcraft>); design_models = load_af2_models(use_multimer_design)[0]; helicity_value = load_helicity(advanced_settings); design_paths = generate_directories(<out>); failure_csv = <out>/failure_csv.csv via generate_filter_pass_csv(default_filters.json); design_name = <tag>_l<binder_len>_s<seed>
recipe.inputs_from_the_case: starting_pdb (--starting-pdb), chain (--chains), length (--binder-len), seed (--seed), target_hotspot_residues (--target-hotspot-residues, BindCraft's grammar verbatim; absent = none), design_name (--binder-name: <name>_l<length>_s<seed>), af_params_dir (--params-dir: <root>/params/params_model_*_multimer_v3.npz)
recipe.settings: settings (the top-level `settings` key: every value read from the file at run time)
recipe.outputs: BindCraft's own tree under <out>/ (generate_directories) with <design_name>.pdb where the triage leaves it and failure_csv.csv, plus the outputs: design.pdb (save_pdb, get_best), design.fasta (get_seqs), trajectory.jsonl (af_model._tmp['log']); the arm's log run.log beside them

reads.AF_PALLAS_ATTN_PRECISE_BWD: common/opt_core/opt_core/kernels/pallas_attn/af2_flash_pallas.py:350 (the carried kernel's backward knob; default off)
reads.AF_PALLAS_ATTN_F32_PRECISION: common/opt_core/opt_core/kernels/pallas_attn/af2_flash_pallas.py make_flash_attention (read by the shared kernel where the core carries the float32-precision word: the matmul precision for float32 inputs, ieee | tf32 | bf16; unset = the core's default ieee = the existing path; colabdesign does not set it)
reads.AF_PALLAS_ATTN_BWD_F32_PRECISION: common/opt_core/opt_core/kernels/pallas_attn/af2_flash_pallas.py:355 (backward matmul precision knob; default: the forward's)
reads.AF_PALLAS_ATTN_DQ: common/opt_core/opt_core/kernels/pallas_attn/af2_flash_pallas.py:359 (backward dQ home: fused | separate kernel; default per DQ_MODE_DEFAULT)
reads.AF_PALLAS_ATTN_DBIAS: common/opt_core/opt_core/kernels/pallas_attn/af2_flash_pallas.py:362 (pair-bias gradient home: xla | kernel; default per DBIAS_MODE_DEFAULT)
reads.AF2M_LEVERS, AF2M_SUBBATCH_FN, AF2M_SUBB: read by no module of this tree: the AF2M design add-on's own switches; a mode is its lever set (opt/colabdesign_opt/modes.py) — kept absent so no arm carries one
reads.COLABDESIGN_OPT, COLABDESIGN_OPT_HOME: the package's own variables (opt/colabdesign_opt/modes.py, stack.py): read by the parent `colabdesign-opt` process only; the arm's mode and paths travel as arguments
reads.COLABDESIGN_OPT_LOWERCACHE: opt/colabdesign_opt/lowercache.py install() (lever lowercache's self-check word `relower`: lower afresh on load and compare first-call outputs bit for bit; in-process routes only; run.sh arms never carry COLABDESIGN_OPT_* -- must_be_absent_prefixes -- so the launcher drops it by name)
reads.KEEP_XLA_DEFAULTS: read by no file of this tree (a self-test switch of the original kit)
reads.XLA_FLAGS: assigned wholesale (`--xla_gpu_enable_triton_gemm=false`) by colabdesign/__init__.py at import in every arm; in the kit arm lever parcompile (opt/colabdesign_opt/launchpad_parcompile.py install) then APPENDS `--xla_gpu_enable_llvm_module_compilation_parallelism=true --xla_gpu_force_compilation_parallelism=<threads>` once, after that assignment and before jax creates a backend; the stock arm carries colabdesign's value alone. Never read by the kit as a switch; the value in force at exit is recorded in each arm's probe (`xla_flags`).
reads.JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR: jax's own persistent-compilation-cache directory variable (read by jax at import): set INTO the kit arm by lever compilecache (opt/colabdesign_opt/compilecache_jax.py install: the caller's value adopted as the cache directory when set, else the keyed default under XDG_CACHE_HOME|~/.cache); stripped from the stock arm (driver.compose) so a caller's cache never warms stock's compiles
reads.JAX_PERSISTENT_CACHE_MIN_COMPILE_TIME_SE: jax's cache thresholds: set to 0 INTO the kit arm by lever compilecache (every executable written); stripped from the stock arm

tolerated: XLA_FLAGS (stock's own: colabdesign/__init__.py:3-4 overwrites it at import)
MODEL_OPT, COLABDESIGN_PARAMS_DIR, MODEL_OPT_TARGET_GPU (deployment paths of configs/<gpu>.env; no lever reads them)

settings.read_at_run_time_by: opt/colabdesign_opt/settings.py (bindcraft.py's default --advanced; `design --advanced FILE` names another; no value of it is typed anywhere in the kit)
settings.filters_for_the_failure_census: stock/src/bindcraft/settings_filters/default_filters.json (bindcraft.py's default --filters; `design --filters FILE` names another; the design step only names its columns in failure_csv.csv)
